title: English Practice Quiz 0865
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Meeting Skills: Move to the next item means:
questions.explanation: It moves discussion to the next agenda item.

questions.question: Meeting Skills: A consensus decision has:
Meeting Skills: Which phrase politely asks to speak?
options: May I make a brief comment?
questions.explanation: It respectfully requests an opportunity to contribute.

questions.question: Meeting Skills: An agenda item needs more time. The chair may:
questions.explanation: The chair manages time and may defer an item.

questions.question: Meeting Skills: An action owner is:
options: the person responsible for completing a task
questions.explanation: The action owner is accountable for the task.

questions.question: Meeting Skills: Which sentence summarises a decision?
options: The team agreed to review the policy next Monday
questions.explanation: It states the agreed action and timing.

questions.question: Meeting Skills: A tentative date is:
questions.explanation: Tentative means not definite or confirmed.

questions.question: Meeting Skills: Meeting minutes contain an error. You should:
options: request a correction through the agreed process
questions.explanation: Corrections should be transparent and follow procedure.

questions.question: Meeting Skills: A round-table discussion encourages:
Meeting Skills: A facilitator should remain:
options: neutral and focused on the process
